mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% year-over-year growth, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by sustained GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches peak capacity and earnings growth decelerates, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized in the latest quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate hiring and higher consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index base 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150,000 monthly) accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000.
